module_summary: UART transmitter: a 4-state FSM sequences start, 8 data, and stop bits, shifting a loaded byte out LSB-first at a baud-counter tick rate.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/START/DATA/STOP controller; drives tx_o mux, ready/busy, shift load and baud reset.

anchors.name: shift_q
anchors.why: Shift register loaded from tx_data, shifted right each data-bit tick; LSB feeds tx_o.

anchors.name: baud_cnt_q
anchors.why: Clock divider counting to CLK_DIV-1, cleared in IDLE; produces baud_tick.

anchors.name: baud_tick
anchors.why: Baud-period strobe advancing FSM, shifting data, and incrementing bit index.

anchors.name: bit_idx_q
anchors.why: Counts transmitted data bits; reaching 7 moves FSM from DATA to STOP.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Input request starting a frame and loading the shift register in IDLE.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready asserted when FSM idle, accepting a new byte.

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: Byte payload loaded into shift_q on accepted request.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial line output muxed by state: start 0, data shift_q[0], else idle 1.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Status flag high whenever FSM not idle.

groups.name: tx_fsm
groups.description: Frame sequencer through start, data, stop states; generates ready/busy.

groups.name: baud_gen
groups.description: Divides clock to bit period and emits baud_tick.

groups.name: tx_shifter
groups.description: Loads byte, shifts out LSB-first, counts bits, drives serial line.
